text.p: Xpedite Systems Inc., a provider of fax and e-mail services, said Monday an investor group that includes certain members of its senior management is interested in acquiring the company for $22.50 cash per share, or $200 million.
The Eatontown, N.J.-based company has about 8.9 million shares, making the deal worth about $200.3 million.
Xpedite said its board has formed a committee to evaluate the offer, as well as strategic alternatives, including possible business combinations and a recapitalization.
Xpedite said it has hired Merrill Lynch & Co. to assist it in the evaluation.
The company's stock edged up 87.5 cents to $22.375 on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
